title: NinaCal processed year file
description: data/processed/{year}.json — harmonized counts per 0.1° cell and month.

cell.description: Grid cell anchor as "<lat>_<lon>", one decimal place.

modis.description: Raw MODIS detection count; null when not measured.

viirs.description: Raw VIIRS S-NPP detection count; 0 before 2012.

harm.description: MODIS-equivalent harmonized count; the only field the calendar uses.
